1	# Ocean Health Multi-Indicator Time Series (1990–2024)
2	
3	## Overview
4	Four global ocean health indicators tracked biennially from 1990 to 2014 and annually from 2015 to 2024, each with distinct units and trend directions, designed to illustrate the compound stress on marine ecosystems.
5	
6	## Data Source
7	
8	### sea_surface_temperature_anomaly
9	- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `anomaly_c` (float, °C relative to 1961–1990 baseline)
10	- **Range**: 0.04 to 0.91 °C
11	- **Trend**: Generally increasing with interannual variability; sharp rise post-2022
12	
13	### ocean_ph
14	- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `ph` (float, dimensionless pH scale)
15	- **Range**: 8.034 to 8.110
16	- **Trend**: Steady decline (increasing acidity); narrow numerical range requiring fine-scale axis
17	
18	### coral_cover
19	- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `cover_pct` (float, percentage of reef area)
20	- **Range**: 11.5% to 33.5%
21	- **Trend**: Long-term decline with a notable drop during the 1998 bleaching event and accelerating loss after 2015
22	
23	### ocean_plastic_pollution
24	- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `plastic_mmt` (float, million metric tons cumulative)
25	- **Range**: 25 to 255 million metric tons
26	- **Trend**: Near-exponential growth throughout the period
27	
28	## Data Notes
29	- Temperature anomalies are modeled global means; regional values vary significantly.
30	- Ocean pH values represent open-ocean surface averages; coastal and deep-water pH differ.
31	- Coral cover estimates are synthesized from GCRMN-style monitoring and carry ±2–4% uncertainty.
32	- Plastic pollution figures are cumulative stock estimates and include modeled seafloor accumulation, which is the largest and most uncertain component.

## Overview
Four global ocean health indicators tracked biennially from 1990 to 2014 and annually from 2015 to 2024, each with distinct units and trend directions, designed to illustrate the compound stress on marine ecosystems.

## Data Source

### sea_surface_temperature_anomaly
- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `anomaly_c` (float, °C relative to 1961–1990 baseline)
- **Range**: 0.04 to 0.91 °C
- **Trend**: Generally increasing with interannual variability; sharp rise post-2022

- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `ph` (float, dimensionless pH scale)
- **Range**: 8.034 to 8.110
- **Trend**: Steady decline (increasing acidity); narrow numerical range requiring fine-scale axis

- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `cover_pct` (float, percentage of reef area)
- **Range**: 11.5% to 33.5%
- **Trend**: Long-term decline with a notable drop during the 1998 bleaching event and accelerating loss after 2015

- **Fields**: `year` (integer, 1990–2024), `plastic_mmt` (float, million metric tons cumulative)
- **Range**: 25 to 255 million metric tons
- **Trend**: Near-exponential growth throughout the period

- Coral cover estimates are synthesized from GCRMN-style monitoring and carry ±2–4% uncertainty.
- Plastic pollution figures are cumulative stock estimates and include modeled seafloor accumulation, which is the largest and most uncertain component.

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as ticker
import numpy as np

# ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
years_biennial = [1990,1992,1994,1996,1998,2000,2002,2004,2006,2008,
                  2010,2012,2014,2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024]

sst = [0.12,0.04,0.15,0.13,0.38,0.24,0.32,0.35,0.37,0.33,
       0.44,0.42,0.46,0.56,0.62,0.54,0.56,0.60,0.64,0.61,0.68,0.82,0.91]

ph  = [8.110,8.107,8.104,8.101,8.098,8.095,8.091,8.087,8.083,8.079,
       8.075,8.071,8.066,8.064,8.061,8.058,8.055,8.052,8.049,8.046,8.042,8.038,8.034]

coral = [33.5,32.8,32.1,31.5,27.2,28.4,27.9,27.3,26.5,25.8,
         25.1,24.2,23.4,22.6,19.8,18.5,17.9,17.1,16.3,15.4,14.2,12.8,11.5]

plastic = [25,30,36,42,49,57,66,76,87,99,
           112,126,141,149,158,167,177,188,198,210,224,239,255]

years = np.array(years_biennial)

# ── Palette ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
C_SST     = '#D62728'   # warm red      – temperature
C_PH      = '#1F77B4'   # ocean blue    – pH
C_CORAL   = '#FF7F0E'   # amber         – coral
C_PLASTIC = '#7B2D8B'   # deep purple   – plastic
BG        = '#F8F9FA'
GRID      = '#D0D5DD'

# ── Figure ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 8), facecolor=BG)
ax1 = fig.add_axes([0.08, 0.13, 0.72, 0.72], facecolor=BG)   # SST  (left-1)
ax2 = ax1.twinx()                                              # pH   (right-1)
ax3 = ax1.twinx()                                              # Coral (right-2)
ax4 = ax1.twinx()                                              # Plastic (right-3)

# Offset the right spines
ax2.spines['right'].set_position(('axes', 1.00))
ax3.spines['right'].set_position(('axes', 1.10))
ax4.spines['right'].set_position(('axes', 1.20))

for ax in [ax2, ax3, ax4]:
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(True)

# ── Plot lines ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lw = 2.2
ms = 5

l1, = ax1.plot(years, sst,     color=C_SST,     lw=lw, marker='o', ms=ms, ls='-',
               label='SST Anomaly (°C)', zorder=4)
l2, = ax2.plot(years, ph,      color=C_PH,      lw=lw, marker='s', ms=ms, ls='--',
               label='Ocean pH', zorder=4)
l3, = ax3.plot(years, coral,   color=C_CORAL,   lw=lw, marker='^', ms=ms, ls='-.',
               label='Coral Cover (%)', zorder=4)
l4, = ax4.plot(years, plastic, color=C_PLASTIC, lw=lw, marker='D', ms=ms-1, ls=':',
               label='Ocean Plastic (MMT)', zorder=4)

# ── Highlight post-2015 acceleration ──────────────────────────────────────────
ax1.axvspan(2015, 2024, alpha=0.07, color='#888888', zorder=1)
ax1.axvline(2015, color='#888888', lw=1.0, ls='--', alpha=0.6, zorder=2)
ax1.text(2015.2, ax1.get_ylim()[1] if ax1.get_ylim()[1] != 1.0 else 0.95,
         'Post-2015\nAcceleration', fontsize=7.5, color='#555555', va='top')

# ── Axis labels & limits ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax1.set_ylabel('SST Anomaly (°C)', color=C_SST, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Ocean pH', color=C_PH, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Coral Cover (%)', color=C_CORAL, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Ocean Plastic (million metric tons)', color=C_PLASTIC, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

ax1.set_ylim(-0.05, 1.05)
ax2.set_ylim(8.025, 8.125)
ax3.set_ylim(8, 37)
ax4.set_ylim(0, 290)

ax1.tick_params(axis='y', colors=C_SST, labelsize=9)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', colors=C_PH, labelsize=9)
ax3.tick_params(axis='y', colors=C_CORAL, labelsize=9)
ax4.tick_params(axis='y', colors=C_PLASTIC, labelsize=9)

ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FormatStrFormatter('%.2f'))
ax2.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FormatStrFormatter('%.3f'))
ax3.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FormatStrFormatter('%.0f'))
ax4.yaxis.set_major_formatter(ticker.FormatStrFormatter('%.0f'))

for ax in [ax2, ax3, ax4]:
    ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)

# Spine colors
ax1.spines['left'].set_color(C_SST)
ax2.spines['right'].set_color(C_PH)
ax3.spines['right'].set_color(C_CORAL)
ax4.spines['right'].set_color(C_PLASTIC)

# ── X axis ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax1.set_xlim(1989, 2025)
ax1.set_xticks([1990,1995,2000,2005,2010,2015,2020,2024])
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=9)
ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=11)

# ── Grid ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax1.grid(True, axis='y', color=GRID, lw=0.7, alpha=0.8, zorder=0)
ax1.grid(True, axis='x', color=GRID, lw=0.5, alpha=0.5, zorder=0)

# ── Legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
leg = ax1.legend(
    handles=[l1, l2, l3, l4],
    loc='upper left',
    fontsize=9.5,
    framealpha=0.92,
    edgecolor='#CCCCCC',
    title='Indicator',
    title_fontsize=9,
)

# ── Annotate endpoints ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax1.annotate(f'+{sst[-1]:.2f} °C', xy=(2024, sst[-1]),
             xytext=(-32, 10), textcoords='offset points',
             fontsize=8, color=C_SST, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_SST, lw=1))

ax4.annotate(f'{plastic[-1]} MMT', xy=(2024, plastic[-1]),
             xytext=(-55, -18), textcoords='offset points',
             fontsize=8, color=C_PLASTIC, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_PLASTIC, lw=1))

ax3.annotate(f'{coral[-1]}%', xy=(2024, coral[-1]),
             xytext=(-30, -18), textcoords='offset points',
             fontsize=8, color=C_CORAL, fontweight='bold',
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_CORAL, lw=1))

# ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.5, 0.94,
         'Multi-Indicator Ocean Health Deterioration, 1990–2024',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', color='#1A1A2E')
fig.text(0.5, 0.905,
         'Sea surface temperature anomaly rising; ocean pH declining; coral cover collapsing; plastic pollution growing exponentially',
         ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, color='#444444', style='italic')

# ── Footer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig.text(0.08, 0.025,
         'Baseline: SST anomaly relative to 1961–1990 mean · pH open-ocean surface average · '
         'Coral cover synthesized from GCRMN monitoring · Plastic estimates cumulative stock (±uncertainty)',
         ha='left', fontsize=7, color='#777777')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight',
            facecolor=BG, edgecolor='none')
print("Saved /app/output/result.png")
